comparison.title: Why this beats
comparison.description: Most translator apps make you type first in a script you don't know. Here's what's different.

rows.title: How you start
rows.us: Speak in English or Russian and get a translation right away.
rows.them: Type your sentence out first, Cyrillic and all.

rows.title: Hearing pronunciation
rows.us: Tap to hear the Russian translation spoken aloud.
rows.them: Text-only results, so pronunciation is left to guesswork.

rows.title: Conversation history
rows.us: Every Russian conversation is saved per language pair.
rows.them: Each translation disappears once you close the app.

rows.title: Getting set up
rows.us: Open it in a browser tab — nothing to install.
rows.them: Download an app before you can translate anything.

rows.title: Both directions
rows.us: English to Russian and Russian to English in one conversation.
rows.them: Switching direction usually means starting over.

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and Russian.

items.q: Does it write Russian in Cyrillic, not transliterated letters?
items.a: Yes, translations appear in proper Cyrillic script, ready to read, hear, or copy.

items.q: Can it translate spoken Russian back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak Russian into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it handle Russian grammar cases correctly?
items.a: Yes, it produces natural Russian with correct grammatical endings, not a rough word-for-word swap.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a Russian keyboard installed?
items.a: No, the app displays Cyrillic automatically — no special keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the Russian translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.

finalCta.heading: Start your English to Russian
finalCta.sub: Speak or type, read or hear it in Russian — free to try, no sign-up.
